message:
A CI pipeline failed on one of the four delivery repos. The failing repo and workflow are in the monitor tags below.

Open the run from the [CI Visibility pipeline list](https://app.datadoghq.com/ci/pipelines) — the failing job and its step log are on the execution's flame graph, and git metadata on the run names the branch and commit.

Triage:
- **One repo, one workflow** -> a real test or lint break; the branch is on the run.
- **Several repos at once** -> shared cause: a harness bump, an Actions runner image change, or an expired token.
- **A rerun passes unchanged** -> flake; worth noting before it becomes routine.

First CI monitor on the estate (RC1-335) — before this, a red run notified nobody. Fly Deploy failures are deliberately excluded here; they have their own, higher-priority monitor.
